biography.plain_text: Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Al Nahyan is an Emirati royal, investor and public official from Abu Dhabi's ruling family, whose dynastic wealth grew from the emirate's oil resources. His personal holdings include Newton Investment and Development, the majority owner of City Football Group, while his chairmanships of Mubadala and the Emirates Investment Authority are sovereign roles rather than personal assets. He also serves as UAE Vice President, with Manchester City making him internationally recognisable.
